svg.title: How stackledger publishes a catalogue
svg.desc: Flowchart. On your Mac, stackledger discover writes a snapshot that stays there, and drift --scaffold suggests entries as you edit catalog/*.yaml. A git push sends the catalogue to the catalogue repository, a private GitHub repository with GitHub Actions. From the repository, a pull request runs gitleaks, validate and build and never deploys; a push to main runs gitleaks, validate and build, with stackledger taken from the npm registry by npx @brunosouzas/stackledger. wrangler pages deploy sends the whole static site to Cloudflare Pages, which never reads GitHub. A reader goes through Cloudflare Access, signing in first, to reach Pages.
